title: OutreachSettingsResponse
description: Response containing outreach settings for a specific outreach type

credentialingCycle.description: Credentialing cycle for which these template/reasons apply

emailRecipientPreferences.description: Email recipient preferences. Null when nothing has been saved for this type/cycle.

template.description: Email template configuration. Null when nothing has been saved for this type/cycle.

outreachReasons.description: List of outreach reasons with instructions. Null when nothing has been saved for this type/cycle.

smartOutreach.description: Smart outreach automation settings. Null when nothing has been saved for this type/cycle.

providerPortalEnabled.description: Whether the provider outreach portal is enabled for this organization. Organization-wide (not per type/cycle); null when the organization has never saved the setting, which consumers must treat as disabled.

stateSpecificPlan.description: Organization-wide state-specific plan settings driving the state_specific_plan dynamic email field (CP-36692). Not per type/cycle; null when the organization has never saved the setting, which consumers must treat as disabled.

OutreachLogoDto.description: Logo settings for outreach email template

enabled.description: Whether to include the logo in emails

id.description: Unique identifier for the outreach reason

isCaqhResolvable.description: Whether the reason is resolvable directly in CAQH (external action, no upload)

submitFormText.description: Text shown to the provider on the submit form for this reason

body.description: Email body content with placeholders (supports HTML/rich text)

OutreachType.description: The outreach configuration category a settings record applies to. PRACTITIONER_CREDENTIALING covers outreach for individual practitioners going through initial or recredentialing review. FACILITY_CREDENTIALING covers the same for facilities. PRACTITIONER_MONITORING covers ongoing monitoring-triggered outreach for practitioners, outside the credentialing review cycle.

businessDaysBetweenAttempts.description: Business days between outreach attempts (display value, persisted as hours)

recredCadenceDays.description: Recredentialing cadence in days (null disables recred override)

dryRunEnabled.description: Dry run mode: evaluate exclusions without sending (per client)

useCalendarDays.description: Count days between attempts on calendar days (weekends/holidays included) instead of business days. Defaults to false (business days).

caqhValidStatuses.description: CAQH provider_status values that qualify as a valid update and suppress outreach. Defaults to ["Reattestation", "Initial Application Complete"] when null or empty.

StateSpecificPlanSettingsDto.description: State-specific plan settings for an organization

enableStateSpecificPlan.description: Whether the state_specific_plan email field resolves through the mapping. Defaults to false when the organization has never saved this setting.

stateSpecificPlanMapping.description: Map of 2-letter uppercase state code to plan name
